description: The four canonical completeness tiers, with thresholds and display semantics.

stub.label: Stub
stub.description: Has identity, almost nothing else. Surfaced as a research prompt.

partial.label: Partial
partial.description: Usable but incomplete. Surfaced in research backlog.

verified.label: Verified
verified.description: Anchor node — well-sourced, corroborated, no open contradictions. Eligible for epistemic_type promotion to 'fact'.

extra_requirements._doc: A node with score ≥0.9 still does NOT promote to verified unless it has at least one corroboration and zero open contradictions

transition_rules.promote_on_score_increase: When score crosses upward through a tier boundary, promote
transition_rules.demote_on_score_decrease: When score crosses downward through a tier boundary, demote
transition_rules.demote_on_contradiction: When a new contradiction appears on a verified node, immediately demote to solid
transition_rules.audit_log: Every promotion/demotion is logged in provenance.extraction_passes with stage='completeness' and the reason
